name: Swiftfin Enhanced
subtitle: Swiftfin with real-time Apple GPU enhancement
description: An unofficial personal Swiftfin fork that follows Jellyfin upstream and adds a thermally adaptive iOS/iPadOS Enhanced player with Apple MetalFX scaling, source-FPS frame pacing, customizable text-subtitle positioning, and a background-safe playback sleep timer. Builds are produced automatically from public source code.

apps.name: Swiftfin Enhanced
apps.subtitle: Jellyfin playback with Apple MetalFX enhancement
apps.localizedDescription: An unofficial build of Swiftfin for iPhone and iPad. It retains Swiftfin's Jellyfin experience and adds an optional AVPlayer-based Apple MetalFX enhancement pipeline with realtime edge-quality profiles, duplicate-render and offscreen-fill suppression, source-FPS frame pacing, bounded processing buffering, automatic thermal and frame-budget throttling, PiP resource suspension, customizable text-subtitle size and black-bar positioning, A/B comparison, a performance monitor, and a background-safe playback sleep timer.

versions.localizedDescription: Automated build from 12d66b3. Includes the MPV player built on libmpv with VideoToolbox hardware decoding and libplacebo rendering, direct play for effectively any container and codec, MetalFX and ArtCNN shader upscaling, an MPV statistics page, screenshots, editable mpv.conf, customizable text-subtitle positioning, trickplay previews with chapter fallback, zoom-to-fill cropping, left-brightness and right-volume gestures, and a playback sleep timer. Also includes current upstream Swiftfin changes.

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Swiftfin iOS uses Bluetooth to discover nearby Cast devices.
privacy.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: Swiftfin iOS uses Bluetooth to discover nearby Cast devices.
privacy.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Swiftfin iOS uses Face ID to lock and access local users.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Swiftfin iOS uses the local network to connect to your Jellyfin server and discover Cast-enabled devices on your Wi-Fi network.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Swiftfin iOS uses your location to identify the current Wi-Fi network.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Swiftfin iOS uses the microphone to listen for ultrasonic tokens when pairing with nearby Cast devices.
